title: P0.86: Startup Truth Refresh Non-Blocking
description: Prevent OSES and PortableContext regeneration from running during startup and blocking the UI/chat lifecycle.
reason: Live runtime after P0.85 showed the bridge became available, but startup_truth_refresh still kept startup_followup_active for minutes, emitted repeated lazy_vm_prebuild_paused events, and caused chat timeouts. The birth path must enable communication first and defer deep metacognition to idle maintenance.
next_action: Restart from the desktop shortcut and verify startup_truth_refresh_skipped_fresh or startup_truth_refresh_deferred_stale appears, startup_followup_active clears quickly, and human_simulated_chat_audit remains 9/9.
resume_hint: Startup truth refresh now skips when artifacts are fresh and defers stale regeneration instead of calling OSES.build_review() and PortableContext.build_package() inline.
